title: Lack of signature cancellation functionality
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `SessionOrderModule.sol` contract allows users to execute orders by signing messages using the `executeSessionOrdersBySig` function. However, no functionality is provided to cancel a previously signed message. This omission poses a security risk, as users may want to revoke or cancel their signed orders in case of a change in intention or if they suspect their private key might have been compromised.
